blockers.reason: The original uniform O(epsilon) claim is false without a uniform separation condition. For the fixed cap z=s,t=-s^2 and approaching strand z=i epsilon, the signed mixed degree-one integral is arctan(1/2)/pi, independent of epsilon. This does not refute convergence for a fixed tangle. The proposed separation/derivative amendment is not yet a completed proof: a term meeting the shrinking cap can also contain short chords farther along the same critical branches, whereas the proposed nested estimate bounds every short parameter by A epsilon. A complete opposite-branch cancellation argument or an explicitly justified sharp-tail geometry is still required. No counterexample to the amended full quotient estimate is claimed here, and no confident ordinary review is fabricated.
